BiblicalUsage: The word means to assemble, and it appears once: Sheba went through all the tribes of Israel, and the Berites were gathered together and went also after him.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the gathering as the last loyalty of a doomed rebellion, and it did not save him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
